$comment: Keeps shipped files from naming a fixed-name path directly under a shared temporary directory (/tmp, /var/tmp or /dev/shm), where any account can create the name first. Evaluated by scripts/check-policies.mjs (checkTempPaths; this file is excluded because its allowed list names the paths). See policies/README.md and docs/security/SECURITY-AI.md, section 'Site-specific data'.
